neighborhoods.title: Choosing the Property Location
neighborhoods.subtitle: The right location increases the value of your investment. Research the neighborhood carefully.

newCairo.name: New Cairo
newCairo.location: East Cairo, near Ring Road & Suez Road
newCairo.commercial: Cairo Festival City, Point 90, Downtown Mall — premium retail & offices.
newCairo.garages: Underground parking in most compounds; surface lots at malls.
newCairo.gardens: Family Park, Al Andalus Park, large private compound gardens.
newCairo.services: International schools (AIS, CAC), hospitals (Dar Al Fouad), gyms, banks.
newCairo.infrastructure: Wide highways, fiber internet, reliable utilities, security gates.

october.name: 6 October City
october.commercial: Mall of Arabia, Mall of Egypt, Dandy Mega Mall — full retail mix.
october.garages: Plentiful surface and basement parking; affordable rates.
october.gardens: Hadayek October, central green spines in Dreamland and Beverly Hills.
october.services: Universities (MSA, MUST, NU), hospitals, supermarkets, mosques & churches.
october.infrastructure: 26th of July Corridor access, metro line under construction, gas grid.

sheikhZayed.name: Sheikh Zayed
sheikhZayed.commercial: Arkan Plaza, Galleria 40, Americana Plaza — upscale dining & shops.
sheikhZayed.garages: Compound-based covered parking; valet at major plazas.
sheikhZayed.gardens: Compound landscaping, Beverly Hills lakes, Allegria golf greens.
sheikhZayed.services: Top international schools, Sheikh Zayed Hospital, premium clinics.
sheikhZayed.infrastructure: New Cairo–Alex desert road, fiber, premium utilities.

northCoast.name: North Coast (Sahel)
northCoast.commercial: Marassi Marina, Hacienda White, Almaza Bay retail strips.
northCoast.garages: Open-air resort parking; villa private garages.
northCoast.services: Seasonal clinics, supermarkets, beach clubs, hotels.
northCoast.infrastructure: Fouka Road shortcut to Cairo (2h), new highways, gas stations.

maadi.name: Maadi
maadi.commercial: Road 9, Maadi Grand Mall, CityStars Maadi — diverse retail.
maadi.garages: Street parking and small underground garages in newer buildings.
maadi.gardens: Tree-lined streets, Wadi Degla Protectorate, sporting club greens.
maadi.services: CAC, embassies, Maadi Military Hospital, Cairo American College.
maadi.infrastructure: Metro Line 1, Ring Road, expat-friendly utilities.

heliopolis.name: Heliopolis & 5th Settlement
heliopolis.commercial: Heliopolis Korba, City Stars, Cairo Festival, Down Town Katameya.
heliopolis.garages: Compound parking; underground at malls and offices.
heliopolis.gardens: Merryland Park, Family Park, private compound gardens.
heliopolis.services: Schools, hospitals (Cleopatra, Air Force), banks, embassies nearby.
heliopolis.infrastructure: Monorail to New Capital, Ring Road, metro extensions.

investment.title: Earn income from your property
investment.subtitle: Rentals, garages, palm groves — discover how every property can pay you back.

legal.heading: Legal Verification
legal.text: Ensure all property documents and title deeds are clear and legally valid. Our in-house legal team reviews every contract before signing — registered with the Egyptian Real Estate Publicity Department.

residential.title: Residential Rentals
residential.location: New Cairo, Maadi, Sheikh Zayed, 6 October
residential.text: Buy a furnished apartment or villa and rent it to expats, executives, or short-term tourists. Average gross yield: 6–9% annually.

garage.title: Garage & Parking Income
garage.text: Purchase a covered parking unit or small lot in dense areas. Monthly rentals to residents and offices generate steady cash flow with near-zero maintenance.

palm.title: Palm Groves & Agricultural Land
palm.location: Siwa, Fayoum, Wadi El Natrun, North Coast hinterland
palm.text: Buy producing palm groves or plant new ones. Annual date harvests plus rising land value give a long-term inflation hedge.

commercial.title: Commercial Spaces
commercial.text: Lease retail units, clinics, or co-working spaces to businesses on multi-year contracts — higher yields than residential.

advisor.title: Talk to an investment advisor
advisor.text: Free 24-hour consultation — we'll match the right strategy to your budget.
